note: T9, opp at 4 life, 3 cards, no creatures, lands mostly tapped; hand City of Traitors, Omniscience, Show and Tell (4 lands, no creature, no cantrip): cast Show and Tell for a lone Omniscience. Opp put in a free Murktide and Prismari Charmed Omniscience on its turn (it knew Omniscience from the Atraxa reveal). Alternative: hold both until Acererak/Atraxa/Veil arrives (drew Veil T11, Acererak T13): then Show and Tell, free Veil, free Acererak loop wins the same turn.

T1 Atraxa reveal, land pick vs a Wasteland deck; hand Island + Tundra, Tomb in play: took City of Traitors over Flooded Strand / Tropical Island / Savannah. A never had a green source, so Veil (and Aluren) stayed uncastable for the rest of the game. Strand (fetches Tropical, dodges Wasteland in hand) looks right; is City ever the pick when blue and 3 mana are already covered?

T7 end step, Atraxa (3 damage marked) targeted by delirium Unholy Heat, opp at 4 life with 5 cards and no creature: cast Force of Will pitching Show and Tell (kept Show and Tell + Omniscience). Opp then had Heat + Bolt next turn anyway. Alternative: let Atraxa die and keep Force to protect the next Show and Tell. And if Forcing, which card to pitch: spare Show and Tell or Omniscience?

T5 at 12 life, 3/3 Murktide that never attacks (Atraxa has vigilance), hand Bolt, Heat x2, Brainstorm: did not chump Atraxa and went to 5. Chumping puts a creature in the graveyard; with the end-step Brainstorm that is delirium, so T6 Heat (6) + Bolt on two Volcanics kills Atraxa a turn earlier at 12 life instead of 4 (Murktide chumped on T7 anyway).
